name: Wipe transition over a cut
description: A bold diagonal orange band with a thin dark trailing edge sweeps across the whole frame in about half a second, fully covering the picture at its midpoint, with a whoosh. Centre it on a jump cut (start = cut time - half the duration) and the cut disappears under the sweep.
use_when: A topic change or a big jump in the footage (walking selfies): hides the cut and marks a new section. Use at most once or twice per video.
